milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because the evaluator's voxel system cannot detect door block state changes (open=true vs open=false) — the block type remains 'oak_door' regardless of state. This rule verifies the player navigated within very close interaction range (1.5 blocks) of the oak door at spawn-relative (0, 0, 6) and is facing it (within ±30° of the door direction). The tight 1.5-block distance ensures the player is close enough to have interacted with the door via right-click, making this the strongest available proxy for door-opening verification.
